title: Analyzing Cognitive Differences Among Large Language Models through the Lens of Social Worldview
reasoning: The paper develops and uses the Social Worldview Taxonomy (SWT) and Questionnaire (SWQ) to evaluate LLMs on socio-cognitive orientations like Egalitarianism, Hierarchy, and Individualism. These dimensions are fundamentally rooted in social ethics, values, and moral structures, and the research explicitly positions itself as an investigation into deeper moral and value-based biases.
